description.narrative: Halvtidsutvärderingen av projektet "Support to Serbian Municipalities on the Road to EU Accession: Enabling High-Quality Services, Stakeholder Dialogue and Efficient Local Administration" förutses i de avtal som Sida tecknade med SCTM respektive SALAR (respektive). Projektet genomförs gemensamt av SCTM och SALAR som ett partnerskapstyp. Implementeringsperioden för bidraget startade i april 2016 och kommer att slutföras i december 2020. Utvärderingskonsulter ska anskaffas genom Sidas avropskontrakt.

The mid-term evaluation of the project “Support to Serbian Municipalities on the Road to EU Accession: Enabling High-Quality Services, Stakeholder Dialogue and Efficient Local Administration” was envisaged in the agreements that Sida signed with SCTM and SALAR (respectively). The project is jointly implemented by SCTM and SALAR as a partnership-type intervention. The implementation period for the contribution started in April 2016 and will be finalized in December 2020. Evaluation consultants shall be procured through Sida's call-off contract.
